defaultEngine.description: Aspirational: IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §6 documents this field, but no runtime code reads it from config.json today - `cli.ts`'s `run`/`doctor` commands resolve the engine only from the `--engine` CLI flag (default "fake"). Kept as an optional property so early adopters of the documented shape do not fail schema validation, but it currently has no effect. See src/config/init.ts's defaultProjectConfigTemplate() comment.

baseBranch.description: Aspirational, not read from config.json today - see the defaultEngine property description.

integrationBranchPrefix.description: Aspirational, not read from config.json today - see the defaultEngine property description.

taskBranchPrefix.description: Aspirational, not read from config.json today - see the defaultEngine property description.

maximumRepairCycles.description: Aspirational as a project-config field: the value that actually governs a run comes from the frozen manifest's budgets.maximumRepairCycles (see manifest.schema.json), read directly in src/run/{fake,claude,codex}-run.ts. This top-level config.json field is not read from anywhere today.

maximumRunMinutes.description: Aspirational as a project-config field: the value that actually governs a run comes from the frozen manifest's budgets.maximumRunMinutes (see manifest.schema.json), read directly in src/run/{fake,claude,codex}-run.ts. This top-level config.json field is not read from anywhere today.

executionEnvironment.description: Aspirational, not read from config.json today - doctor resolves the execution profile from .ai-code-worker/execution-environment.example.json (or the packaged template), not from this config.json field. See the defaultEngine property description.

testedVersionRanges.description: Project-level override for the codex adapter's version allowlist (src/doctor/doctor.ts's defaultCodexConfig()). Read by loadProjectConfig() and merged in codexAdapterConfigFromProject(); use this instead of editing the source default when a newer CLI version hasn't had its behavior verified yet.

dangerouslySkipPermissions.description: Explicit opt-in to Claude Code's --dangerously-skip-permissions. Use only when the worker process is already externally sandboxed and the disposable/task worktree is the intended write boundary.

testedVersionRanges.description: Project-level override for the claude adapter's version allowlist (src/doctor/doctor.ts's defaultClaudeConfig()). Read by loadProjectConfig() and merged in claudeAdapterConfigFromProject().

baseArgs.description: Arguments inserted before every ai-code-control subcommand, for example the path of a published DLL when executable is dotnet.
